## Invitations

The outreach activity generated 1898 invitations during the reporting period. Of those invited, 1330 people attended, representing an attendance rate of 70.1 per cent. This provides a clear measure of engagement with the invitation process and supports ongoing monitoring of participation.

Attendance tends to dip in winter and recover in spring. This seasonal pattern should be considered when reviewing results and planning future outreach activity. Continued monitoring will help identify whether changes in invitation methods or follow-up arrangements affect attendance.

## Contact

SMS contact was used alongside the invitations. A total of 1602 invitations went with an SMS, and 1602 people received a reminder message. The consistent use of SMS and reminder messages provided an additional point of contact for those invited and supported communication before attendance.

These figures should be retained for comparison with future outreach reporting. The report was prepared by G. Evans.
